## Recall · Files and the cloud

a) What keeps an older copy of your files that a mistake does not reach?
b) You delete a file on the lab computer. What happens on your synced phone?
c) Which date format sorts file names by date?

::: {.answer}
a) a backup
b) It is deleted too.
c) year-month-day, like 2026-11-29
:::

## Recall · Word

a) What does Word use to build the table of contents?
b) You added a heading. What do you click so that the contents show it?
c) The cover must have no page number. What do you tick?

::: {.answer}
a) the heading styles
b) Update Table
c) Different First Page
:::

## Recall · Excel

a) The sales of five days add up to 150 JD. What does =AVERAGE give?
b) You copy =B2/\$B\$7 from C2 to C5. What is in C5?
c) What does the fill handle do?

::: {.answer}
a) 30
b) =B5/\$B\$7
c) It copies the formula down.
:::

## Summary

- A good file name has the date, what it is and a version.
- Sync copies every change, but a backup is a separate copy.
- Heading styles make the table of contents, and Update Table keeps it right.
- SUM, AVERAGE and MAX work on a range, and \$ keeps a reference.
- The practice quiz shows the part that you study again before the exam.
